Status: The base of the requests (FR-WFL-002, FR-REQ-001): the eight visible phases of BR-WFL-011, the six request types of S3 with their audiences (the roles that hold req.create: RQ, TM, FO, TE), and the five seeded template graphs of spec 13 section 5.5 (PURCHASE_LC, CHILD_AMENDMENT, CHILD_STANDARD for the document and the SWIFT request, GENERIC_SIMPLE, GENERIC_APPROVAL). The types are written inactive; the installer publishes each template as the tenant's service user and then activates its type (BR-REQ-001: a type is active only with a published template, an audience and a numbering key, CORE.NUMBERING v3). CANCEL is not a template row: the engine adds it from every non-terminal stage, and the release of a reservation runs on entering the REJECTED and CANCELLED stages (S3 brief OQ-6). The SLA hours are spec 13's proposals. A proposed default written by an AI agent.
Sources: docs/30-readiness/DOC-F10 and DOC-F11 (template proposals DQ-F10-1 to 13, hooks DQ-F11-1 to 9)
Templates: templates/*.json: one graph per file (BankFas.Core.Workflow.TemplateGraph), stages and roles named by key and code.

NotSeeded.PROFORMA_REQUEST, SALES_ORDER_APPROVAL,: Templates of S4 (sales letters of credit).
NotSeeded.req.assign_number: The request number is allocated by the engine on entering the template's NumberOnStageKey (BR-WFL-013), so no hook row carries it.
